findings.title: admitBuildComplete trusts the body-supplied requestingRun instead of resolving it through the authority port
findings.trigger: Future B02/B05 caller wires a client-supplied run body into admitBuildComplete; run role/taskId/ownerMemberId/executionEnvironmentId decide eligibility and approval-scope environment but are never checked against port.resolveRunRecord
findings.consequence: An auditor-owned principal can forge role=builder on a run they own with an in-scope environment and admit build complete; breaks the brief rule that the port resolves authoritative run records for every mutation and the no-request-body-trust rule
findings.verification: Full source read; only port calls in admitBuildComplete are actor/approval/attempt-count; forged-run-body case untested (test at programmeDomain.test.ts L521 covers actor resolution only)

findings.title: recordReview ignores review.disposition (and declared lineageCheck/coverage) while deriving acceptance from the gates
findings.trigger: A review with disposition rejected/incomplete (or lineageCheck failed) that passes all fact gates
findings.consequence: Work item transitions to accepted while the returned/persisted review says rejected or incomplete; contradicts PRD 02 L148 disposition rule; gates still gate so no authority bypass
findings.verification: No disposition comparison exists in recordReview; no test exercises a mismatched disposition

findings.title: Approval.targetIds is never enforced
findings.trigger: Approval scoped to target workitem-A used to admit workitem-B in the same project/environment/spec
findings.consequence: Brief deny list 'excluded path/target/effect/environment' only 3/4 implemented; approval scope wider than the human approved
findings.verification: Full read of requireApprovalCovering; no targetIds check anywhere; test matrix bullet 4 has no target denial test

findings.title: Port run/evidence/source lookups carry no orgId; tenant scoping implicit
findings.trigger: A trusted-store implementation keying those records without an org dimension
findings.consequence: Contract does not force org isolation on those lookups; today only indirect via projectId/taskId equality checks
findings.verification: Interface read; no failing behaviour in this slice; recommend orgId parameters when B02 lands the store
